course_subtitle: Welcome to the magical world of 3D programming! Here you will control cameras, apply the laws of gravity and physics, build a solar system and play 3D shooting games. Open the terminals and enter the third dimension!

stations.title: Station 1: Coordinates and 3D camera
stations.desc: Learn how to control the triple coordinates (X, Y, Z) and direct the camera to revolve around the characters skillfully.
stations.story: Welcome, future hero, to the 3D world! The screen here is not flat, but rather has a depth (Z) in addition to height and width. We use camera blocks to make it revolve around the object and see it from all directions.
stations.simple: Like 3D PlayStation games (such as Fortnite and Minecraft)! You can turn the camera and see the character's back and side and truly live the game!
stations.hint: Type in the editor: print("Camera and 3D coordinates set successfully") and press Run!
stations.challenge: Print the magic statement Camera and 3D coordinates were set successfully to simulate the camera.

pills.label: 3D camera settings
pills.code: print("The camera and 3D coordinates have been set successfully")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The camera and 3D coordinates have been set successfully

stations.title: Station 2: Gravity and realistic physics
stations.desc: Activate the physics engine and make the ball fall due to gravity, hit the ground and bounce in a completely realistic way!
stations.story: Physics makes the games real! We use physics blocks (activating gravity) to make objects fall down, hit walls, and bounce based on their flexibility and weight.
stations.simple: Like real football! When you let it go, it falls to the ground and bounces several times until it stands on its own due to gravity!
stations.hint: Type print("The ball fell and hit the ground due to gravity").
stations.challenge: Print the magic phrase The ball falls and hits the ground due to gravity to simulate physics.

pills.label: Gravity run
pills.code: print("The ball fell and hit the ground due to gravity")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The ball fell and hit the ground due to gravity

stations.title: Station 3: Steering the 3D race car
stations.desc: Program your 3D racing car to move forward and turn left and right on the amazing race track!
stations.story: Driving 3D cars is very exciting! We program the car's wheels to respond to keyboard arrows, and we add momentum to the engine to send the car off the 3D track.
stations.simple: Need for Speed ​​games! You drive the car, step on gasoline, and damage the right and left of the middle of the buildings and the track!
stations.hint: Type print("The 3D race car took off skillfully").
stations.challenge: Print the magic sentence The 3D racing car sped off to simulate the movement of the car.

pills.label: Run a race car
pills.code: print("The 3D racing car started off skillfully")

stations.title: Station 4: Solar system simulation
stations.desc: Make a 3D model of the solar system and make the planets revolve around the sun at different speeds!
stations.story: Outer space is amazing in the third dimension! We place a model of the sun in the center, and program the Earth and the rest of the planets to rotate in continuous circular orbits at varying speeds.
stations.simple: Planetarium costume in the museum! You see the planets in holograms and orbiting around the sun in a wonderful and amazing system!
stations.hint: Type print("The planets orbit the Sun in 3D orbits").
stations.challenge: Print the statement The planets orbit the sun in 3D orbits to simulate the motion of the planets.

pills.label: Planetary rotation 3D
pills.code: print("The planets revolve around the sun in three-dimensional orbits")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The planets revolve around the sun in three-dimensional orbits

stations.title: Station 5: 3D duck hunting game
stations.desc: Program the movement and direction of the 3D sniper to hunt ducks flying in the sky and score points skillfully!
stations.story: Shooting games require precision in vectors! We program the movement of the 3D cursor to follow the movement of flying ducks, and when shooting we check whether a collision has occurred (Raycasting).
stations.simple: Like a duck hunting game with a gun in an amusement park! You shout at the duck that is flying and hit it so that it falls and wins the prize!
stations.hint: Type print("The flying duck is caught and the 3D point is calculated").
stations.challenge: Print the magic sentence The flying duck has been caught and calculate the 3D point to simulate a hunting game.

pills.label: Duck hunting 3D
pills.code: print("The flying duck was caught and the 3D point was calculated")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The flying duck is caught and the 3D point is counted

stations.title: Station 6: 3D game interfaces and sounds
stations.desc: The grand final stop! Combine scoreboard (UI Canvas) and sound effects to bring out your 3D game like a professional!
stations.story: The grand final stop in the 3D world! We'll integrate a UI Overlay to display points and a power meter, with a surround soundtrack to complete your masterpiece!
stations.simple: Like the TV screen in the match! The game is running in 3D in the background, and the score and time are written above very clearly!
stations.hint: Type print("The full 3D game ran successfully and the hero won!").
stations.challenge: Print the closing phrase The 3D game has been fully run successfully and the champion wins! to celebrate the completion of your first 3D game!

pills.label: Run the final 3D game
pills.code: print("The entire 3D game has been run successfully and the hero has won!")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The fully 3D game runs successfully and the hero wins!
